2610.09297.title: Node-level Graph Neural Architecture Search Framework
2610.09297.paper_summary: In recent years, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and architecture search frameworks have gained extensive application in non-Euclidean data processing, attributable to their superior capacity in managing unstructured data. Nevertheless, traditional approaches typically apply uniform convolution operations to all nodes, regardless of their varying structural and feature characteristics, which can undermine model performance and result in over-smoothing issues as the number of layers increases. To overcome this limitation, in this work, we propose a \textbf{N}ode-Level \textbf{G}raph \textbf{N}eural \textbf{A}rchitecture \textbf{S}earch (N-GNAS) algorithm. It can automatically choose an appropriate network architecture for each subset of nodes when updating node features. N-GNAS also introduces a contrastive learning loss to separate sample features from different categories and vice versa. In experiments conducted on eight datasets for node and graph classification, our methodology outperforms current leading GNAS techniques and traditional human-designed GNNs. For example, it achieves an accuracy rate of 78.26\% on the CiteSeer dataset.
2610.09297.paper_summary_zh: 近年來，圖神經網絡（GNNs）和架構搜索框架在非歐幾里得數據處理中得到了廣泛應用，這歸因於它們在處理非結構化數據方面的卓越能力。<lb/>然而，傳統方法通常對所有節點應用統一的卷積操作，而不考慮它們不同的結構和特徵特性，這可能會削弱模型性能，並隨著層數的增加導致過度平滑問題。<lb/>為了克服這一限制，在這項工作中，我們提出了一種\textbf{N}ode-Level \textbf{G}raph \textbf{N}eural \textbf{A}rchitecture \textbf{S}earch（N-GNAS）算法。<lb/>它可以在更新節點特徵時自動為每個節點子集選擇合適的網絡架構。<lb/>N-GNAS還引入了一種對比學習損失，以區分來自不同類別的樣本特徵，反之亦然。<lb/>在針對八個數據集進行的節點和圖分類實驗中，我們的方法超越了當前領先的GNAS技術和傳統的人為設計GNN。<lb/>例如，它在CiteSeer數據集上達到了78.26\%的準確率。
